packageRules.description: Every fastframe crate comes from the same tag. They are git dependencies, whose package name is the repository URL, so the rule matches the crate names.
egui's crates release together, and the apps patch them to crmne/egui: a lone crate never builds, and a new minor waits for the fork.
winit is patched to crmne/winit apps-0.30 in every app; it moves with the fork.
